A stacked fraction is two baselines with a rule between them, and on the page it means one quantity.

12/116

The numerator is a sum, so the solidus form needs it bracketed.

(1 + 2)/3

The denominator is a sum, and takes the brackets on the other side. Its bar is drawn at the same extent as the bar above it.

12/(3 + 4)

The rule below this paragraph divides nothing, and is the shape a fraction bar has.

It reaches far past both lines it sits between, where a bar is drawn for the expression it divides.
